title: ChatWeave Generation Control (0.1)
description: Responses of the generation-control endpoints (paths chosen by the host, see docs/protocol.md 4.6): starting a generation returns the assistant message id synchronously (or startRejected while an interrupt is open); stopping is an explicit, idempotent request distinct from disconnecting; a per-conversation query lists messages still being generated so a client killed before it learned the id can re-attach. These are not block actions and do not use the Action protocol.

startResponse.description: Returned by the host's submit-user-message endpoint BEFORE generation produces output. Resubmitting the same user message id returns the same assistant messageId with replayed=true and never starts a second generation.

userMessageId.description: Client-generated id of the user message (idempotency key).

messageId.description: Server-generated id of the assistant reply.

startRejected.description: Returned by the host's submit-user-message endpoint when it refuses to start because the conversation has an open interrupt that this user can answer (docs/protocol.md 4.8 rule 16, D62). The user message is not stored and no generation starts; the client shows the pending card and locks the composer (keeping the draft). Hosts that cannot refuse a submission (e.g. an offline-queued message) instead stop the paused message first and start normally.

pending.description: The paused message and its open interrupt.

stopResponse.description: Result of POST .../messages/{messageId}/stop. stopping: generation is being cancelled (also for a paused message: its open interrupt is closed as cancelled / reason 'stopped'); a message.end with status interrupted and error code cancelled follows. already_ended: nothing to stop; use the persisted message.

activeMessagesResponse.description: Result of GET .../conversations/{conversationId}/active-messages: messages that have not ended (streaming or paused). Empty list when there are none. A list because a group conversation may have several generations at once.

lastSeq.description: Last seq emitted so far (0 if none yet).

status.description: streaming (default): being generated. paused: waiting for the user to answer an interrupt (docs/protocol.md 4.8); the message is listed until it ends so a client can show the question and resubscribe after answering.

replyTo.description: Id of the user message this generation answers, so a client can match its pending user message.
